objective: Predict the house sale price from the tabular features in train.csv; the metric is RMSE on log price, reported as its negative so that higher is better.

members.emphasis: Gradient-boosted trees on raw features with target encoding of categoricals.
Regularized linear model on one-hot features with log-transformed skewed numerics.
A small MLP on standardized features with early stopping on the validation split.

rubric: Prefer the candidate with the lowest validation RMSE that also generalizes: reject a candidate whose validation split leaked into training, and prefer simpler models when scores are within 0.01 of each other.
